name: max_parallel_maintenance_workers
description: Sets the maximum number of parallel background worker processes that a single maintenance command (e.g., CREATE INDEX, VACUUM) may use.
symptoms: Maintenance operations not scaling with hardware
tuning_tips: Increase this value to match available CPU cores and I/O capacity, but ensure it does not exceed max_worker_processes; start with min(4, number_of_cpus) and adjust based on observed throughput and resource contention.
